feature_query_sql:
SELECT airport, cutoff, target_rate, target_n, label_available_at,
       sched_n_2h, hour, dow, month, lag_rate_2h, lag_rate_6h,
       observed_n_2h, backlog_n, temp_c, wind_ms, visibility_m,
       weather_age_min, upstream_rate, weather_available_at, max_event_available_at
FROM features WHERE target_n > 0 AND target_rate IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY cutoff, airport
target: Fraction of scheduled departures in next 2h that cancel or depart >=15 minutes late
unit: airport-hour cutoff with at least one scheduled target departure
selection_rule: Lowest average August/September validation MAE; never selected using October-December labels

availability_assumptions: Final reported schedule treated as known; BTS has no historical schedule snapshots.
Gate-out events assumed available 15 minutes after their occurrence, including eventual cancellations; not verified operational feed latency.
ISD observations assumed available 60 minutes after observation; archival corrections may differ from real-time feed.
Cancellation publication times unavailable: cancellations enter labels only; backlog is unresolved scheduled departures, not known cancellations.

graph_contribution.comparison: temporal_residual MAE minus graph_residual MAE, same tabular base and OOF residual rows

uncertainty.method: circular seven-day moving-block bootstrap, 1000 draws, seed17
uncertainty.caution: Descriptive resampling interval for this carrier/year; not a guarantee under regime changes.

graph_contribution.interpretation: Positive is an improvement; an observed negative result is retained. No claim of general superiority or significance.

limitations: One carrier and eight focal airports in 2023; excludes passenger, crew, maintenance and non-WN propagation.
Overlapping 2h labels are serially dependent; point metrics are descriptive, without independence-based confidence claims.
Final schedules, revised archival observations and assumed feed latencies limit deployment interpretation.
Graph is a train-period scheduled-route adjacency and a linear temporal message residual, not observed future rotations or a large GNN.
No severe-event probability is estimated: calibration is mean predicted versus mean observed disruption rate; severe recall uses a 0.5 rate threshold.
